abilities.description: Fluent in the Terraces' tapping language, she can send and decode messages across the acoustic halls unnoticed.
abilities.name: Tapping Codes

abilities.description: She spots hidden debts and forged entries in account books.
abilities.name: Forensic Ledger Reading

characters.arc: She moves from defending the Terrace Charter to using the truth about the Silent Bell to force a new, fairer settlement of oaths and debts.
characters.description: Youngest daughter of House Veyra, raised on the Choir Terraces among tapping codes and sealed letters. She is slight and pale, with ink-stained fingers and an old oath-ring she keeps turning on her hand. Trained as her house's ledger-keeper, she alone knows how deep the debt to the Lamp Guild runs.
characters.external_conflict: The Lamp Guild is squeezing House Veyra, and her own relatives want to buy Bell Warden loyalty by illicit means.
characters.flaw: She trusts written records over people and misreads those who lie well in person.
characters.goal: Restructure House Veyra's debt to the Lamp Guild before the light is cut from the Terraces.
characters.internal_conflict: She loves her house but suspects its founding charter rests on a lie, and exposing it could destroy it.
characters.motivation: To keep her family from being cast out through the outer doors for broken oaths.
characters.name: Isolde Veyra

abilities.description: He can dim or restore lamps across districts through Guild contracts.
abilities.name: Leverage of Light

abilities.description: He reads trade rumors and predicts shortages before they happen.
abilities.name: Market Sense

characters.arc: His grip tightens until a crisis proves light and air cannot be owned. He must choose between ruin and sharing power.
characters.description: Master Chandler of the Lamp Guild, a broad, soft-spoken man with lamp-oil burns on his forearms. He rose from a leviathan-rendering floor to run the Guild's lending, and he remembers every slight. He speaks courteously while pricing everything in hours of light.
characters.external_conflict: He is trying to outmaneuver House Veyra and the Wardens at once, while Guild rivals murmur that he has overreached.
characters.flaw: He cannot imagine people acting from anything but profit, which leaves him blind to loyalty and sacrifice.
characters.goal: Place Guild loyalists among the Bell Wardens and force House Veyra to surrender its oaths.
characters.internal_conflict: He privately fears that controlling the bells would make him responsible for the city's every breath.
characters.motivation: To make the Guild untouchable by owning the nobles' oaths and so ending the memory of his own poverty.
characters.name: Marcus Dray

abilities.description: He can tell from a bell's tone whether the pumps and doors are in order.
abilities.name: Bell Reading

abilities.description: He catches faint answers from the crypt's stone when he speaks within it.
abilities.name: Hearing the Stone

characters.arc: He breaks his vow of silence, sharing what he finds with Isolde, and chooses truth over the order's secrecy.
characters.description: A lean, wary Bell Warden acolyte who tends the pumps beneath the altar. Orphaned in a pressure-door sealing, he joined the Wardens for the order's silence and the bells' steady rhythm. He wears a grey cowl and has gone half deaf in one ear.
characters.external_conflict: Senior Wardens watch him closely while both the Guild and House Veyra try to recruit him.
characters.flaw: He is secretive to the point of paralysis and shares nothing even with those who could help.
characters.goal: Find proof of the saboteur's identity inside the Bell Crypt records.
characters.internal_conflict: His loyalty to the order conflicts with his growing belief that the Wardens covered up the truth.
characters.motivation: To discover who silenced the bell during the Night of the Silent Bell, which killed his family's district.
characters.name: Oren Tallow

abilities.description: She can pitch her voice to carry or vanish in the Terraces' acoustics.
abilities.name: Carrying Voice

abilities.description: She maintains informants in every district.
abilities.name: Web of Informants

characters.arc: After her bargaining nearly gets Isolde killed, she gives up a profitable secret to protect her.
characters.description: A freelance broker and former chorister who deals in secrets between the Nave stalls and the Terraces. She is tall and sharp-eyed, with a singer's carrying voice she keeps carefully low. She belongs to no faction and sells to all.
characters.external_conflict: Marcus Dray has begun buying up her debts, and the Wardens have noticed her interest in the crypt.
characters.flaw: Greed keeps her bargaining when she should walk away.
characters.goal: Broker a deal that sells the Silent Bell truth to the highest bidder.
characters.internal_conflict: She wants freedom, but her trade makes her dependent on the powers she betrays.
characters.motivation: To buy enough secrets to afford a safe, independent life away from every guild and house.
characters.name: Seraphine Voss

relationships.description: Marcus Dray holds House Veyra's debts and uses them to pressure Isolde Veyra into surrendering her family's oaths.
Isolde Veyra studies Marcus Dray's ledgers to find the flaw in his contracts and counter his plans for the Bell Wardens.
Oren Tallow slowly comes to trust Isolde Veyra, sharing crypt evidence about the Silent Bell with her.
Seraphine Voss sells information to Isolde Veyra and grows genuinely fond of her, though she keeps bargaining with the Silent Bell secret.
Marcus Dray buys Seraphine Voss's debts to turn her into a Guild informant against House Veyra and the Wardens.
Seraphine Voss pursues Oren Tallow for crypt secrets, while Oren distrusts her and refuses to be bought.
